Religion, Politics and Society

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Radboud Religion, Politics and Society studies religious traditions, texts, practices and contemporary social questions. Comparative study of religions connects with anthropology, sociology, philosophy and research on power, migration, media and cultural change.

UCR offers useful philosophy, myth, cultural heritage, politics and media study. These contributions do not build the sustained comparative study of religious traditions and religion-specific research at the centre of this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a sufficiently close alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary full-time bachelor; Religion and Care plus Worldviews, Nature and Climate modules

The 180 EC framework includes 120 EC of required study, two complete 15 EC modules and 30 EC of free choice. Each selected module has three 5 EC courses. Research includes a supervised project and a 10 EC individual final work. RADAr-NL carries no credits; an equivalent university test can support exemption. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 44 EC. External electives and internships need applicable approval; professional careers may require further qualifications.
